prompt_text:
Please respond to the following ticket if you are able to. 
You have access to the following commands:
"escalate": Use this if you can not solve the issue, leave some suggestions for the escalated agent, in the notes, if possible.
"reply": Restarts the users Workspace account
"close": Close the ticket if no further action is needed.
"resolved": Mark the ticket as resolved.

Use the following json format to reply:
{
"command": "",
"reply": "", //the reply to be sent to the user, optional
"note": "", //leave an internal note for other agents
"reason": "", //the reason for this action
}

Related Knowledgebase solutions:
Problem: User is unable to download VNC Viewer and needs assistance.
Solution: Instruct the user to install VNC Viewer from the Self Service application found on their desktop or in their start menu.

Ticket:
Bob posted 03/05/2023, 09:22 Urgent Bug request
Good Morning,

I am trying to download a VNC on my computer in order to access RemoteSiteA and it is blocking me from downloading. Please can you have a look as soon as possible as I need to be able to access the hospital diary?

Many Thanks,
Bob
response_text:
{
  "command": "resolved",
  "reply": "Hi Bob,

You can install VNC Viewer directly from the Self Service application on your computer. Please open Self Service (you’ll find it on your desktop or in the Start menu), search for “VNC Viewer,” and click Install. Once the installation completes, you should be able to launch VNC Viewer and connect to RemoteSiteA.

If you encounter any further issues, feel free to let us know.

Best regards,
Support Team",
  "note": "Provided user with instructions to install VNC Viewer via Self Service as per KB solution.",
  "reason": "User unable to download VNC Viewer; provided standard installation guidance and marked ticket as resolved."
}
